config.title: Latency Distribution
config.description: Requests per second in each latency bucket over time

dataStream.name: query

dataSourceConfig.query:
WITH (
    sec = sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket|http_server_duration_seconds_bucket"}[5m])),
    ms = sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket|rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket"}[5m]))
)
label_set(sec, "unit", "s") or label_set(ms, "unit", "ms") or label_set(vector(0), "unit", "none", "le", "0")

dataStream.sql:
WITH buckets AS (
    SELECT
        "timestamp",
        "unit",
        CASE WHEN "unit" = 's' THEN TRY_CAST("le" AS DOUBLE) * 1000 ELSE TRY_CAST("le" AS DOUBLE) END AS "le_ms",
        SUM("value") AS "cumulative"
    FROM "dataset"
    WHERE "unit" IN ('s', 'ms') AND "value" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
per_bucket AS (
    -- Difference cumulative buckets within each histogram family before combining them,
    -- so families with different bucket boundaries don't get subtracted from each other.
    SELECT
        "timestamp",
        "le_ms",
        GREATEST("cumulative" - COALESCE(LAG("cumulative") OVER (PARTITION BY "timestamp", "unit" ORDER BY "le_ms"), 0), 0) AS "requests"
    FROM buckets
    WHERE isfinite("le_ms")
)
SELECT
    "timestamp",
    ROUND("le_ms", 3) AS "latencyMs",
    SUM("requests") AS "requestsPerSec"
FROM per_bucket
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY "timestamp", "latencyMs"

dataSourceConfig.query:
WITH (
    total = sum by (op) (label_copy(label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count|rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count"}[5m]), "http.route", "op", "http_route", "op"), "rpc.method", "op", "rpc_method", "op")),
    failed = sum by (op) (label_copy(label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", http.response.status_code=~"5.." or __name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", http_response_status_code=~"5.." or __name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", http.status_code=~"5.." or __name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_seconds_count|http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", http_status_code=~"5.." or __name__="rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count", rpc.grpc.status_code=~"2|4|12|13|14|15" or __name__="rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count", rpc_grpc_status_code=~"2|4|12|13|14|15"}[5m]), "http.route", "op", "http_route", "op"), "rpc.method", "op", "rpc_method", "op")),
    pct = 100 * (failed or 0 * total) / total,
    sec = sum by (op, le) (label_copy(label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket|http_server_duration_seconds_bucket"}[5m]), "http.route", "op", "http_route", "op"), "rpc.method", "op", "rpc_method", "op")),
    ms = sum by (op, le) (label_copy(label_copy(rate({__name__=~"http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket|rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket"}[5m]), "http.route", "op", "http_route", "op"), "rpc.method", "op", "rpc_method", "op")),
    pms(q) = 1000 * histogram_quantile(q, sec) or histogram_quantile(q, ms)
)
label_set(label_replace(total, "op", "(no route)", "op", "^$"), "kpi", "rate") or label_set(label_replace(pct, "op", "(no route)", "op", "^$"), "kpi", "errorPct") or label_set(label_replace(pms(0.95), "op", "(no route)", "op", "^$"), "kpi", "p95")
